title: Saratoga National Cemetery is in need of a Contractor who can provide Turf Fertilizer, Pre-Emergent Crabgrass & Broadleaf Weed Control Services. -- S208
description_text: Saratoga National Cemetery is in need of a Contractor who can provide Turf Fertilizer, Pre-Emergent Crabgrass & Broadleaf Weed Control Services. -- S208 To provide Turf Fertilization, Pre-Emergent Crabgrass & Broadleaf Weed Control Services at the Gerald B.H. Solomon (Saratoga) National Cemetery, located at 200 Duell Road, Schuylerville, NY 12871 and at the Albany Rural Soldiers Lot. The Contractor shall furnish all supervision, labor, equipment, materials and supplies necessary to provide Turf Fertilization, Pre-Emergent Crabgrass & Broadleaf Weed Control Services at the Gerald B.H. Solomon (Saratoga) National Cemetery, located at 200 Duell Road, Schuylerville, NY 12871 and at the Albany Rural Soldiers Lot which is within the Albany Rural Cemetery, located on Route 32, Menands, NY 12204. Areas of turf for treatment include all burial areas, the assembly area, committal shelters and main entrance leading to public information center and the 150 grass area along Duell Road outside of the cemetery on each side of the main entrance. The entire cemetery acreage to be treated is approximately 75 acres.
